title: 옆자리
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. A grand piano plays sustained chords and melodic fills in the upper register. A clean electric guitar provides subtle rhythmic accents. The arrangement features a male tenor vocal with a wide dynamic range, utilizing breathy delivery in the lower register and powerful chest voice in the higher register. Orchestral strings enter with legato phrasing, building in volume and density. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The production uses high-fidelity reverb on the vocals and strings to create a large acoustic space.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[sustained piano chords, subtle clean electric guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male tenor vocals]
같은 책상에 앉아있던 그 등
수학시간에 옆으로 치우친 그 어깨
누군가는 답을 알고
누군가는 모르고
우리는 그렇게 나란히 앉아만 있었어

[Pre-Chorus]
말 한마디 건네본 적 없는데
왜 자꾸 그 등이 떠오르는가

[Chorus]
[orchestral strings enter, vocal intensity increases]
짝꿍이라는 이
